data.one_liner: Quick, familiar, and extensible form management and validation for Flutter without code generation.
data.what_it_does: Manages form state, values, errors, and touch status without complicated boilerplate. It provides ready-to-use form widgets like text fields, checkboxes, sliders, and rules for validation, while remaining fully reactive for dynamic fields and rules.
use_when: You need a straightforward form solution with built-in validation rules.
You want to manage form state locally without Redux or BLoC.
You require dynamic fields or rules that can change at runtime.
avoid_when: You prefer compile-time type safety via code generation.
You already manage your entire application state inside a global state management library.
strengths: No complex configuration or code generation required.
Fully reactive, supporting dynamic fields and rules in flight.
weaknesses: Relies on dynamic types internally rather than static generics.
Limited to synchronous validation rules out of the box.
